verdict.rationale: Teams has a documented app platform with app publishing, connectors, message extensions, and Graph-based integrations (ms-teams-docs-7, ms-teams-docs-12, ms-teams-docs-30), implying an app catalog/store for admins to add prebuilt apps, but the evidence pack lacks direct docs on the admin-facing app directory/marketplace install flow itself, and community feedback notes integration is more complex than competitors like Slack (ms-teams-comm-11).
